dedupe_keys.name: dataset of resource and environment atlas for the purpose of supporting and serving the planning construction and green development of guangzhou

description: Dataset of Resource and Environment Atlas for the Purpose of Supporting and Serving the Planning, Construction and Green Development of Guangzhou is a data set described in the paper "Dataset of Resource and Environment Atlas for the Purpose of Supporting and Serving the Planning, Construction and Green Development of Guangzhou" in Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery (Editorial Office of Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery, 2019), produced by Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System (the data publisher; the open metadata names no authors). The Dataset of the Resource and Environment Atlas for the Purpose of Supporting and Serving the Planning, Construction and Green Development of Guangzhou (also referred to as the Atlas), a professional integrated atlas in geology, was prepared based on a collation and summary of the latest materials and results obtained from hydrogeological, engineering geological and environmental geological surveys. Coverage: Guangzhou, China. The data are held on Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-10-01). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support urban planning and green development support. Related record: the journal-level record for Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery.
